Schema-drift comment in _mcp_models.py:31-34 is now accurate on main (BridgeFsckOut declares binding_drift and CI drift gate exists); treat as DO_NOT_MOVE rather than a correction target.

Machine-consumed CI markers in _config_schema.py (12 read-via annotations) and wire-visible MCP tool docstrings in _mcp_llm.py (~121 lines) must remain verbatim; deleting either breaks CI or API surface.

_config_schema.py contains ~280 comment-only documentation lines for keys absent from docs/config.md (completion_floor_active, comment_max_chars, auth_proxy_secret_env); recovery of more than ~34 lines requires writing docs/config.md rows first to avoid documentation loss.

Four stale-wording corrections were made in review_bot (config.py:56 and app.py:143 shutdown wording; SEVERITIES and blocking_severities vestigial notes); three multi-line inline rationale blocks were relocated to ADRs 0067/0068/0069 with one-line citations.
Test suite and CI gates (pytest, ruff, mypy, check_config_reads.py) all passed unchanged; no runtime logic was altered; only comment/docstring/docs text was modified.
